design_goal.question: How can the exact public inputs of TWIN-COUNTEREXAMPLE-001 be replayed into the accepted fourteen-field A17-P1e deterministic depth-1 request, with an optional fail-closed readonly check against a pinned historical Twin resource-trace row, without changing P10 or elevating SELECT_ACTION beyond candidacy metadata?
not_a_goal: caller runtime, fixture, or test implementation in RED
finite-domain expansion or a second A17 grid cell
Part B, Path B, named-open, or full M3* elevation
mint, admission, Kernel or E_case write
certificate, system-state authority, STOP, or CERTIFIED_STOP

accepted_prerequisite_pins.boundary: Does not open Part B, full M3*, production execution, or STOP.

calls: src.planner.deterministic_depth1.validate_resource_trace_binding only when exact historical-row validation is requested

caller_input_hash.constraint: Canonical SHA-256 of the exact caller input with caller_input_hash omitted.

return_contract.decision_record_rule: When the P1e gate is called, this is the exact seventeen-field object returned by evaluate_depth1_planner_request, value-for-value and without added, removed, or rewritten fields. It is null only when the caller denies before the gate.
return_contract.resource_trace_binding_receipt_rule: Null in NONE mode or when no SELECT_ACTION binding exists; otherwise the exact receipt returned by validate_resource_trace_binding for the selected unmodified historical row. No MATCH status is promised for the current historical rows.

mapping_rows.source: Exact equality-checked fixed counterexample, Gamma, and compiled finite problem

mapping.compiled_legal_world_ids: UTF-8 sorted unique compiled world IDs
mapping.current_u_world_ids: exact full compiled_legal_world_ids; no addition, deletion, or inferred world

mapping_rows.source: Equality-checked expected/outcome.yaml and frozen counterexample public result fields

mapping.checker_run_hash: canonical hash of the other six exact checker-binding fields

mapping.counterexample_hash: canonical_value_hash of the entire frozen counterexample document
mapping.distinguishing_predicates_hash: canonical_value_hash of the exact sorted list

mapping_rows.source: Pure DistinguishingActionSelector result from the pinned counterexample and catalog

mapping.selection_record_hash: canonical hash of allowed_actions, sorted forbidden_actions, and catalog_actions_examined=8

mapping_rows.source: Pinned catalog observation models plus frozen compiled legal-world predicates under the exact two-rule projection registry
mapping_rows.mapping: One hash-bound total partition per P4-allowed action; actions and world rows are in canonical UTF-8 order.
mapping_rows.explicitly_not_a_source: expected/action_observations.jsonl observed_value; actual observations may not be laundered into a model partition

mapping_rows.source: Exact request_seed.resource_budget_seed from the pinned accepted P1e fixture
mapping_rows.mapping: Deep copy the eight-field P1E-BUDGET-TWIN-001 declaration, recompute budget_hash with budget_hash omitted, and do not use cost in V(a) or tie-break.
Canonical SHA-256 over the complete exact fourteen-field request with request_hash omitted.

mapping_invariants: Every source file and declared content identity must match its exact pin before the P1e gate is called.
The caller never accepts a user-provided path, URI, wildcard, world, predicate, observation model, probability, confidence, hidden ID, or oracle field.
The current U is the exact two-world compiled set and cannot be expanded.
The fixed observed action rows are not used as true-world labels or as D1 partition outcomes.
All intermediate hashes are replayed before the top-level request hash is computed.
The generated request has exactly the accepted P1e fourteen fields.

deterministic_partition_projection_regis.rule: For each frozen compiled world, output present iff the exact predicate credential_activity:H1 is present; otherwise output absent under the pinned bounded-completeness declaration.

For each frozen compiled world, require exactly one public predicate authentication_origin:H3=<value>; output that value only when it is an exact member of the pinned catalog output_domain. Missing, duplicate, or outside-domain values DENY the whole request.

optional_historical_resource_trace_bindi.row_selector: Exact attempt_id ATTEMPT-001, ATTEMPT-002, or ATTEMPT-003; no wildcard, row-number fallback, or best match.
optional_historical_resource_trace_bindi.row_passed_to_validator: The selected parsed row is passed unmodified to validate_resource_trace_binding.

facts: Every historical Twin row has seven legacy fields but lacks planner_decision_record_hash and resource_budget_hash required by the accepted P1e TRACE_INPUT_FIELDS.
Every historical attempt_id is ATTEMPT-00N and therefore differs from the decision-basis-derived P1e attempt_id.
ATTEMPT-001 records query_logon_origin_H3, while the accepted D1 exact tie-break selects query_auth_H1_1000_1015.
not_authorized_remedies: inject missing decision or budget hashes and call the result historical
change the D1 tie-break or selected action
change the historical attempt or action ID
material_compatibility_finding.owner_review_question: Accept that GREEN may exercise the exact historical rows only as deterministic fail-closed binding negatives, while the default no-binding path returns the candidacy sidecar with a null receipt; any successful companion binding would require a separately explicit test-only receipt fixture authorization.

mismatch_effect.decision_record: returned unmodified as non-executable candidacy metadata

proof_obligations_for_green: Do not modify KernelE2ERunResult, DeterministicKernelE2EDriver, or to_outcome_fields.
Do not add planner_decision, P1e request, P1e decision, sidecar, or receipt to the existing P10 outcome fields.
Keep the existing regression assertion self.assertNotIn("planner_decision", first).
Run the existing P10 tests unchanged and require full PASS.
Run the new caller independently and assert its sidecar is not merged into P10 result or system state.
The caller runtime must not import or call DeterministicKernelE2EDriver; P10 supplies pinned fixture identity and a regression boundary only.

explicit_non_substitutes.reason: They prove the D1 contract, not the Twin/P10 public-input caller mapping.
P4 is an eligibility filter and does not calculate D1 value or grant execution authority.
P5 replays frozen observations and must never receive SELECT_ACTION from this caller.
Its outcome deliberately has no planner_decision field and remains unchanged.
planner_execution_authority=false and it is outside this Part A fixed-case wiring slice.
They classify structural candidacy only and are not widened by this slice.

proposed_green_test_plan: Require exact five-field test-only authority before loading Twin inputs or calling the P1e gate.
Require exact twelve-field caller input and deterministic caller_input_hash replay.
Reverify every prerequisite, protected runtime, and fixed public-input content SHA before request construction.
Build exactly fourteen request fields from TWIN-COUNTEREXAMPLE-001 and assert equality with a pinned caller fixture.
Call evaluate_depth1_planner_request and assert the nested decision object equals the direct gate result value-for-value.

Assert SELECT_ACTION, query_auth_H1_1000_1015, exact rational values, UTF-8 tie-break, stable request hash, stable decision hash, stable attempt ID, probability_model=null, planning_confidence=null, and all authority flags false.
Repeat identical input and assert the complete sidecar record and all hashes are identical.

Assert hidden/oracle, observed-value laundering, probability/confidence, stale pin, wrong case, wildcard path, current-U expansion, malformed projection, and authority requests fail before gate or through the accepted P1e DENY path without partial action emission.
In NONE mode assert receipt is null and no historical trace row is mutated.

For ATTEMPT-001, ATTEMPT-002, and ATTEMPT-003, pass each exact historical row unmodified to validate_resource_trace_binding and assert deterministic DENY_TRACE_BINDING_MISMATCH receipts; assert the trace file SHA remains unchanged.
Assert no call to P5, no action invocation, no system-state derivation, no production registration, and no filesystem write.
Run existing P1e unit and trace-binding tests unchanged.
Run existing P10 tests unchanged and preserve self.assertNotIn("planner_decision", first).
Reverify protected P4, P5, P10, P1e, Twin helper, and both historical trace pins at zero drift.

owner_review_questions.proposal: Accept the exact twelve-field caller input and five-field test-only authority gate, with all data paths internal and hash-pinned.
Accept the exact public mapping into the existing fourteen-field P1e request, including the two-rule deterministic partition registry and the explicit ban on using observed_value as model truth.
Accept an independent eight-field sidecar result that nests the direct P1e decision and optional receipt unmodified and grants no authority.
Accept P1E-TWIN-TRACE-FINDING-001: current historical Twin rows can only produce fail-closed binding receipts, not MATCH, and must not be rewritten or enriched to fake compatibility.
Accept P10 as an unchanged regression boundary with no planner_decision field and no runtime import/call from the proposed caller.
Keep the exact six-file GREEN allowlist unauthorized until Owner accepts this RED and explicitly opens GREEN.

red_verification_plan.porcelain: Owner GO plus exactly RED design and RED review packet

hard_boundaries: Path A / Kernel design GREEN must not be inferred as L2 PASS, Part B PASS, or unrestricted Part B elevation.
SELECT_ACTION is candidacy metadata only and cannot authorize P5 or any other execution.
A16 remains reestablished only for the accepted Part A frozen finite-domain scope and is not expanded by this wiring RED.
P10 remains a fixed-case input and regression boundary, not an execution-authority source.
A RED acceptance would authorize no GREEN file, runtime, fixture, test, commit, push, or pull request.
